captions.detailed: A classic five-reel slot machine cabinet with a dark matte finish, a blue header panel, a glass-covered reel display, and an angled control deck. The control deck features a prominent red push button and an orange rectangular accent bar. The five multi-colored reels rotate continuously on parallel horizontal axes, the red spin button depresses prismatically, and a rear maintenance panel hinges open from the back.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a five-reel casino cabinet featuring a main black chassis, a blue display header, and a protruding control deck. Add five rotating cylindrical reels behind a transparent viewing window, a red spring-loaded push button on the deck, and a hinged rear door.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body, base, and control deck using combined box primitives. Create the five reels by aligning cylinders along a shared horizontal axis, assigning distinct color segments to each. Model the button as a cylinder within a sleeve, and define its motion as prismatic, while setting the reels to continuous rotation and the back panel to revolute joint motion.
